entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think you may know[n]this already...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I've been ordered by[n]Principal Kobayakawa to[n]look for the culprits.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, the ones responsible[n]for the calling card.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We seem to be fine for now, but[n]we can't let our guard down.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I ask that you try not to[n]stand out for a while.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way, I usually spend my[n]time in the student council room.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If there's ever an emergency,[n]feel free to come find me there.
entries.uk: Якщо раптом щось термінове,[n]можеш знайти мене там.
